title: Convex attractor geometry, exact stability formulas and large-gain uniqueness for the Wilhelm–Heinrich oscillator
description:
Unrefereed mathematical candidate. A written proof establishes a unique attracting positive periodic orbit of the Wilhelm–Heinrich system when r0 is at least 1000 max(a0,b0)^2/min(a0,b0). The positive-interior attractor is a graph of a convex function; its domain is a closed Jordan disk only above Hopf. Exact multiplier formulas reduce the remaining uniqueness question to an all-cycle sign condition.

Version 3.1 corrects a derivative and a Hessian interpretation, adds outward rational bounds for 56 selected scalar comparisons, and derives the formerly assumed local slow-graph property from Eldering Theorem 3.2. The small-rate-ratio result remains local in a fixed energy ball. All-parameter uniqueness, global wedge uniqueness, formal verification, external specialist review and historical priority are not established. Floating-point experiments are finite diagnostics, not orbit enclosures. Original prose/data CC0-1.0, original code MIT; historical third-party material retains its rights.
